# CCZ MOD Knowledge Base

Read in this order:

1. 00-共性知识/README.md
2. 00-共性知识/07-源码级制作与安全写回规则.md for source-derived patches or writes
3. Select one version: 6.5/README.md, 6.5pl/README.md, or 6.6/README.md
4. Use index.json to find canonical topic entries
5. Use 90-来源归档/source-manifest.csv only for evidence and provenance

Never apply an address, resource offset, table layout, or injection rule across versions without an explicit evidence entry.
